scripts.build: pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site build && pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app build && pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site test && pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app test && pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud typecheck
scripts.quality: pnpm --filter @quillframe/product-site quality && pnpm --filter @quillframe/studio-app quality && pnpm --filter @quillframe/cloud quality
scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
